purpose: Close the numeric frame-timing evidence gap from ORA_RIDE_UI_MAP_FINAL_AUDIT (prior debug build emitted 0 ORA_FRAME samples).

build.note: Staging Cloud Run is DOWN (GCP billing disabled). API base pointed at local stub (stub_auth_api.py + adb reverse tcp:8081) so the app could pass /auth/me and reach the map UI. Frame timing measures client-side rendering; backend identity is irrelevant to these numbers.

rootCauseOfPriorZeroSamples.finding: bool.fromEnvironment('ORA_FRAME_TIMING') only accepts the string 'true' — value '1' falls back to defaultValue=false, so the logger was never installed in either the prior debug build or this run's first profile build (=1: 0 samples confirmed).
rootCauseOfPriorZeroSamples.fix: No app-code change — rebuilt with ORA_FRAME_TIMING=true. Instrumentation itself is adequate.

procedure: adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 (device -> local stub)
Home -> tap 'Where are you headed' -> ride-request compose (MapLibre preview, real tiles)
gestures via adb input: Expand map -> 6 pans -> double-tap zoom -> 2 long drags -> Collapse -> 4 compact pans -> sheet scroll -> expand -> 2 pans

interpretation.whatWasMeasured: Flutter FrameTiming via WidgetsBinding.addTimingsCallback -> debugPrint 'ORA_FRAME n buildMs rasterMs totalMs' -> logcat (main.dart::_installFrameTimingLogger).
interpretation.caveat_totalMs: totalMs is totalSpan (build start -> raster end, spans vsync); >16.67ms here does NOT equal a dropped frame. The actionable budget numbers are buildMs and rasterMs vs the 16.67ms frame deadline.
interpretation.caveat_fps: No FPS figure is claimed — the log carries per-frame durations only; no display refresh-rate or jank-threshold policy is invented.
interpretation.honestReading: UI thread (build) is light (median 0.42ms). Raster is the heavier side during map gesture/tile work (median 7.86ms, p95 18.84ms). Worst tail (totalMs max 275.69ms) is cold-load/expand transient.

limitations: Backend was a local stub — no real rides/offers data loaded; map surfaces are backend-independent for rendering.
Gestures were scripted adb swipes/taps, not human finger input — representative but not organic.
Single device, single ~69s window; no sustained-load or thermal measurement.
Pinch-zoom not driven (adb input is single-pointer); double-tap zoom used instead.
Profile build points at stub URL — do NOT distribute or treat as staging build.
verdict: NUMERIC_EVIDENCE_CAPTURED — 856 real FrameTiming samples on SM-A325F profile build; prior 0-sample gap root-caused to ORA_FRAME_TIMING=1 vs bool.fromEnvironment parsing.
